Shanghai Municipal Council Report 1936

Report for the Year 1936 and Budget for the Year 1937, Part I
Shanghai Municipal Council; Shanghai: North-China Daily News & Herald, 1937

All tables and lists are transcribed, including the small tables set in the text, the figures printed on charts, the accounts and the budget (each department or sub-head of the financial statements and budget is a separate table); the prose, the photographs, the posters and graphs without printed figures are not. Table pages were found from contact sheets by Claude Sonnet 5.5; light pages were read once by Claude Haiku 5.5, dense pages and long schedules by Claude Sonnet 5.5. Not checked by eye. Printed totals were re-added by the readers: totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted. Figures that could not be read are marked [?] (64 cells, 0.1%); some are at the right edge of pages that the scan clips. Part I only: the contents list the report (pp. 1–252); the accounts (Part II) and budget (Part III) follow in the same volume.
